questions.title: Delete beside Edit
questions.contentMdx: On the Qanda discussion site, the creator of a thread sees three buttons under it, as in the screenshot `thread.png`. Edit lets the creator change the thread. Delete removes the thread straight away and sends the user back to the dashboard. Like adds a like. Mei is the creator of this thread and wants to edit it.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: What about the design of these three buttons makes it easy for Mei to press Delete by mistake?
subQuestions.answerMdx: All three buttons look the same (same colour, size and style) and sit right next to each other with almost no gap, so nothing sets Delete apart from Edit and Like, and a slightly off click lands on the wrong one.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for the identical styling and/or the tiny gap that gives no visual separation between Edit and Delete.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 这三个按钮的设计有什么问题，会让 Mei 很容易误点到 Delete？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 三个按钮外观完全一样（同样的颜色、尺寸和样式），而且彼此紧挨着、几乎没有间隙，所以 Delete 和 Edit、Like 之间没有任何视觉区分，手稍微偏一点就会落到错误的按钮上。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：指出三个按钮样式完全相同，和/或间距过小，导致 Edit 与 Delete 之间没有视觉区分。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Describe one change that makes an accidental delete less likely, and one different change that makes it less costly when it still happens.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Less likely: ask "Delete this thread?" and wait for a confirmation before deleting; style Delete differently from the other buttons (for example red or outlined); or move or space Delete away from Edit and Like. Less costly: let the user undo the delete straight afterwards, or keep deleted threads somewhere they can be restored from.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for a change that reduces the chance of the mistake (confirmation step, different styling, or moving / spacing Delete away).
1 mark for a different change that reduces the cost after the mistake (undo, or a place deleted threads can be restored from).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请分别给出一个改法：一个让误删更不容易发生，另一个让误删即使发生代价也更小。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 降低发生概率：删除前弹出 "Delete this thread?" 等待确认；把 Delete 与其他按钮做成不同样式（例如红色或描边）；或把 Delete 移开、拉开距离。降低代价：删除后立刻提供 undo，或者把已删除的帖子放到可以恢复的地方。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：给出一种降低误删概率的改法（二次确认、不同样式、把 Delete 移开或拉开间距）。
1 分：给出另一种降低误删代价的改法（undo，或可恢复删除内容的地方）。

questions.titleZh: 紧挨着 Edit 的 Delete
questions.contentMdxZh: 在 Qanda 讨论站点上，帖子作者会在这条帖子下方看到三个按钮，如截图 `thread.png` 所示。Edit 让作者修改帖子；Delete 会立即删除帖子并把用户送回 dashboard；Like 用来点赞。Mei 是这条帖子的作者，她想修改这条帖子。

questions.title: An empty dashboard
questions.contentMdx: `dashboard.png` shows the Qanda dashboard for a user who has just registered and has no threads yet. The only way to create a thread is the "+" in the header. In a usability test, 8 new users were asked to start a discussion. 5 said the page "was still loading" or "looked broken". The other 3 found the "+", but only after more than a minute.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Every tester's dashboard was working correctly, but they did not realise it. Why not, and what might they have expected to see that would show the page was working?
subQuestions.answerMdx: The blank area below "Dashboard" looks the same whether the threads are loading, failed to load, or there are no threads. Nothing on the page tells these apart, so testers assumed the list had not arrived yet or had failed. They would have expected the page to say what state it is in: a message such as "You have no threads yet" once the list has loaded empty (or a "Loading..." indicator while it is still loading).
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for explaining that the blank area is indistinguishable from loading or failed, and for naming an explicit state message (an empty-state message, or a loading indicator).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 每位测试者的 dashboard 其实都工作正常，但他们没意识到。为什么？他们本期望看到什么，才能表明页面是正常的？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 因为 "Dashboard" 下方那片空白，在帖子正在加载、加载失败和确实没有帖子这三种情况下看起来一模一样，页面没有任何东西能区分它们，所以测试者以为列表还没到或加载失败了。他们本期望页面明确写出自己处于什么状态：当列表加载完但为空时显示类似 "You have no threads yet" 的文案（加载中时则显示 "Loading..." 指示）。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：解释空白区域与加载中 / 加载失败无法区分，并指出需要一个明确的状态文案（空状态提示，或加载指示）。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Describe how the "+" for creating a thread could be shown instead so that new users find it easily, and give an example HTML element, with CSS, for your idea. Inline CSS is accepted.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Replace the small icon-only "+" with a clearly labelled button, such as "Create your first thread", placed in the empty area below "Dashboard" where new users are already looking. Style it as the main action on the page: larger, with padding and a filled background in the site's colour, so it stands out. The text label says what it does, so users do not have to guess what "+" means. For example: `<button style="padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 18px; background: #2b3a67; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 6px;">+ Create your first thread</button>`.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for a labelled, prominent primary button placed in the empty area (not just an icon).
1 mark for example markup / CSS that makes it the main action (padding, filled background, a readable label).
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请描述一种改法：把创建帖子的 "+" 换一种展示方式，让新用户容易找到，并给出一个示例 HTML 元素和 CSS（允许内联 CSS）。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 把只有小图标的 "+" 换成一个带清晰文字标签的按钮，例如 "Create your first thread"，放在 "Dashboard" 下方那块新用户本来就在看的空白区域里。把它做成页面上的主行动作：更大、有 padding、用站点主色的填充背景，让它跳出来。文字标签直接说明它能做什么，用户就不用猜 "+" 是什么意思。例如：`<button style="padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 18px; background: #2b3a67; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 6px;">+ Create your first thread</button>`。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：给出一个带文字标签、醒目、且放在空白区域内的主按钮（不能只是一个图标）。
1 分：示例 markup / CSS 体现了它作为主行动作（有 padding、填充背景、可读的文字标签）。

questions.title: A token that runs out of its comment
questions.contentMdx: On the Qanda thread page each comment is shown in a box. Ben pastes a long login token into his comment. The markup and styles are in `index.html` and `style.css`, and `comments.png` is a screenshot of the page.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Ben's sentence wraps onto new lines inside the box, but the token runs straight out of it. Why does the token not wrap too?
subQuestions.answerMdx: The browser only breaks lines at places where it is allowed to, such as spaces (and hyphens). The token is one very long "word" with no spaces in it, so there is nowhere to break it. It is wider than the 360px box, and because the box has a fixed width it cannot grow, so the token overflows past its edge.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for explaining that line breaks only happen at allowed break points (spaces / hyphens) and the token has none, so it overflows the fixed-width box.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: Ben 的那句话能在框内自动换行，但 token 却直接冲出了框。为什么 token 不会换行？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 因为浏览器只会在允许换行的位置断行，例如空格（以及连字符）。而这个 token 是一个不含空格的超长 "单词"，没有任何可以断行的位置。它比 360px 的框还宽，而框又是固定宽度、不会变大，所以 token 就从框的边缘溢了出去。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：解释浏览器只在允许的断行点（空格 / 连字符）换行，而 token 没有任何断行点，因此溢出固定宽度的框。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: A teammate suggests adding `overflow: hidden` to `.comment`. Describe what Ben's comment would look like then, and give a better CSS fix with the reason it is better.
subQuestions.answerMdx: With `overflow: hidden`, the overflow is removed, but the end of the token would be cut off at the right edge. Other users will not see or copy the whole token. A better fix is `overflow-wrap: anywhere` (or `overflow-wrap: break-word`, or `word-break: break-all`) on the comment text. It allows the browser to break inside a word when the word cannot fit on a line, so the token wraps onto several lines inside the box.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for describing that `overflow: hidden` clips / cuts off the end of the token.
1 mark for a correct wrapping fix (`overflow-wrap: anywhere` / `break-word`, or `word-break: break-all`) with the reason that it lets the browser break inside the long word.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 队友建议给 `.comment` 加上 `overflow: hidden`。请描述那时 Ben 的评论会变成什么样，并给出一个更好的 CSS 修法以及它更好的原因。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 加了 `overflow: hidden` 之后，溢出虽然消失了，但 token 的尾部会在右侧被裁掉，其他用户既看不到、也无法复制完整的 token。更好的修法是在评论文本上加 `overflow-wrap: anywhere`（或 `overflow-wrap: break-word`，或 `word-break: break-all`）。它允许浏览器在这个单词一行放不下时从单词内部断开，于是 token 会在框内折成好几行。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：描述 `overflow: hidden` 会把 token 的尾部裁掉。
1 分：给出正确的换行修法（`overflow-wrap: anywhere` / `break-word`，或 `word-break: break-all`），并说明它允许浏览器在长单词内部断行。

questions.title: Buttons that jump
questions.contentMdx: A Qanda post contains a 600 by 300 pixel sketch, with Reply and Like buttons underneath. The markup and styles are in `index.html` and `style.css`. Mei is on slow Wi-Fi. `loading.png` shows the page just after it appears, and `loaded.png` shows it about two seconds later, after the sketch has downloaded. Mei went to click Reply as soon as the page appeared, but her click landed on the sketch.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Why do the Reply and Like buttons move down when the sketch finishes downloading?
subQuestions.answerMdx: The `` tag does not define the picture's size, so the browser does not know its size until the file is downloaded. Until then it gives the image no space, and the buttons just sit under the text. When the 600 by 300 picture arrives, the browser makes room for it and pushes everything below it down by about 300px.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for explaining that the `` has no declared dimensions, so no space is reserved until the download finishes and the later layout shift pushes the buttons down.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 为什么草图下载完成时，Reply 和 Like 按钮会向下移动？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 因为 `` 标签没有定义图片尺寸，浏览器在文件下载完成前并不知道它有多大。在这之前，图片不占任何空间，按钮就紧贴在文字下面。当这张 600 × 300 的图片到达后，浏览器为它腾出空间，把下方所有内容整体往下推了大约 300px。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：解释 `` 没有声明尺寸，下载完成前没有预留空间，之后的布局位移把按钮推了下去。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Describe a change to the page that stops the buttons from moving, and explain why it works.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Add the picture's size to the tag: ``. The browser then knows how big the image will be before the file arrives, so it reserves a 600 by 300 box straight away. The buttons start in their final position and nothing moves when the picture appears.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for setting explicit `width` and `height` (or `aspect-ratio`) on the ``. 1 mark for explaining that the browser can then reserve the space before the image loads, so nothing shifts.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请描述一种能让按钮不再移动的页面改法，并解释它为什么有效。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 把图片尺寸写进标签：``。这样浏览器在文件到达之前就知道图片会有多大，于是立刻预留出一个 600 × 300 的盒子。按钮一开始就处在最终位置上，图片出现时也不会再有东西移动。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：在 `` 上显式设置 `width` 和 `height`（或 `aspect-ratio`）。 1 分：解释这样浏览器能在图片加载前就预留空间，因此不会发生位移。

questions.title: Helpers for the register page
questions.contentMdx: The Qanda team keeps two helper functions for the register page in `helpers.js`. `parseReply` turns the server's JSON reply into a list of thread titles. `showError` puts a message into the page's error popup. In the page, `helpers.js` is loaded with a script tag in the `head`, above the `div` with the id `error-container`. `runtime-order.svg` shows the Node test calls and the browser's document order.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: The team wants to check these functions automatically with Node, without opening a browser, by calling each one with test input. One function can be checked this way and the other cannot. Which one cannot, and why?
subQuestions.answerMdx: `showError` cannot. `parseReply` only uses `JSON.parse` and `map`, which are part of the JavaScript language and so work in any runtime, including Node. `showError` uses `document`, which is added by the browser and does not exist in Node, so calling it stops with "document is not defined".
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for naming `showError` and explaining it uses the browser-only `document` object, which Node does not provide.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 团队想用 Node 自动测试这两个函数（不开浏览器，直接传入测试输入调用）。其中一个可以这样测，另一个不行。哪一个不行？为什么？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `showError` 不行。`parseReply` 只用到 `JSON.parse` 和 `map`，它们属于 JavaScript 语言本身，在任何运行时（包括 Node）里都能工作。而 `showError` 用到了 `document`，这是由浏览器提供的对象，Node 里并不存在，所以调用它会以 "document is not defined" 报错中断。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：指出是 `showError`，并解释它使用了 Node 不具备的浏览器专属对象 `document`。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: On the register page, a teammate adds the line `showError('Welcome back')` at the bottom of `helpers.js` so that it runs as soon as the file loads. What happens on the page, and why?
subQuestions.answerMdx: The call fails with an error ("Cannot set properties of null") and no message appears. The script is in the head, so it runs before the browser has built the page body. The `error-container` div does not exist yet, so `getElementById` returns `null` and there is nothing to put the text into.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for explaining that `getElementById` returns null because the head script runs before the `error-container` div exists, so the call throws.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 在注册页上，队友在 `helpers.js` 底部加了一行 `showError('Welcome back')`，让它在文件一加载时就执行。页面上会发生什么？为什么？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 这次调用会以 "Cannot set properties of null" 报错，且页面上不会出现任何消息。因为脚本在 head 中，会在浏览器构建出页面 body 之前就执行，此时 `error-container` 这个 div 还不存在，所以 `getElementById` 返回 `null`，没有任何元素可以写入文本。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：解释由于 head 中的脚本在 `error-container` 这个 div 存在之前运行，`getElementById` 返回 null，因此调用报错。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Instead, the teammate leaves the script tag in the head and calls `showError('Passwords do not match.')` from the register form's submit handler. A user submits mismatched passwords. Does the message appear, and why?
subQuestions.answerMdx: Yes, the message appears. The handler only runs when the user submits the form, long after the page has loaded, so by then the `error-container` div exists. Where the script tag sits matters only for code that runs immediately when the file loads.
subQuestions.markingMdx: 1 mark for explaining the message appears because the submit handler runs after the page has loaded, when `error-container` exists.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 另一种做法：队友把 script 标签留在 head 中，改从注册表单的 submit 处理器里调用 `showError('Passwords do not match.')`。用户提交了两次不一致的密码。消息会出现吗？为什么？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 会出现。因为该处理器只有在用户提交表单时才会运行，那时页面早已加载完成，`error-container` 这个 div 已经存在。script 标签放在哪里，只对文件加载时立即执行的代码有影响。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh: 1 分：解释消息会出现，因为 submit 处理器在页面加载完成后才运行，那时 `error-container` 已存在。

questions.title: Super like
questions.contentMdx: Each Qanda thread shows its like count with two buttons. "Super like" is meant to add 2 likes. `page.png` shows the buttons for a thread with 12 likes. `LikeButtons.jsx` contains the code.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: The thread has 12 likes. The user clicks "Super like" once. What number is displayed, and why?
subQuestions.answerMdx: 13. During this render `likes` is the constant 12. Both calls to `like` run `setLikes(likes + 1)` with that same 12, so both ask React to set the value to 13. The second call does not see the first call's result.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for stating 13.
1 mark for explaining both calls read the same 12 and both request 13, so the second does not add on top of the first.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 这条帖子有 12 个赞。用户点一次 "Super like"。显示的数字是多少？为什么？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 显示 13。在这次渲染中，`likes` 是一个值为 12 的常量。两次 `like` 调用执行的都是 `setLikes(likes + 1)`，用的都是同一个 12，所以两次都在请求 React 把值设成 13。第二次调用看不到第一次调用的结果。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：答出 13。
1 分：解释两次调用读到的都是同一个 12、都请求设为 13，所以第二次不会在第一次基础上叠加。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: A teammate adds `console.log(likes)` as the last line of `superLike`. What does it print on that click, and why?

questions.contentMdx: `OrderPanel.jsx` loads an order summary. React prints a warning when the effect runs, and a failed request leaves the loading message on screen.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: OrderPanel has two symptoms: React warns about the function passed to `useEffect`, and a failed request leaves "Loading order..." on screen. What separate cause produces each symptom?
subQuestions.answerMdx: An `async` function returns a Promise, so the function passed to `useEffect` returns a Promise. React expects that function to return nothing or a cleanup function. 1 mark for explaining that a failed request skips `setLoading(false)`.

subQuestions.questionMdxZh: OrderPanel 有两个症状：React 对传给 `useEffect` 的函数发出警告；并且请求失败后 "Loading order..." 会一直留在屏幕上。这两个症状各自由什么原因造成？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `async` 函数会返回一个 Promise，所以传给 `useEffect` 的函数返回了 Promise，而 React 期望这个函数不返回任何东西、或只返回一个 cleanup 函数。另一方面，fetch 或 JSON 解析失败会让代码跳过 `setLoading(false)`；代码里没有任何失败处理，于是 loading 一直为 true。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：解释 `async` 回调返回的是 Promise，而不是空值 / cleanup。
1 分：解释请求失败会跳过 `setLoading(false)`。
1 分：把“缺少失败处理”和“加载提示一直留在屏幕上”联系起来。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: How should the effect be reorganised so it can keep the `await` style, turn loading off after success or failure, and stop an older order request from updating the panel?
subQuestions.answerMdx: Pass a regular function to `useEffect`, then define and call an async function inside it. That inner function can use `try` for the request, `catch` to store an error, and `finally` to turn loading off. The effect's cleanup should abort the older request or mark it as unable to update state. The async function should change `order`, `error`, or `loading` only for the current `orderId`.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for a non-async effect that defines and calls an async function inside.
1 mark for `try` / `catch` / `finally` that always clears loading.
1 mark for cleanup that aborts or ignores a stale request (guarding on `orderId`).

questions.title: Hotel route parameters
questions.contentMdx: The travel browser uses React Router so a hotel and its selected room can be opened directly or restored after a refresh, by using the URL. `room-page.svg` shows the page at `/travel/42/room/3`. `TravelBrowser.jsx` contains the route and the component.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: A user refreshes `/travel/42/room/3`. What room does the component render, and what information is missing from its current route setup?
subQuestions.answerMdx: It renders room 1, because the component always initialises `roomNumber` to 1. The route declares a `:roomNumber` parameter, but the component does not read that parameter and use it as its initial or controlled room number.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for stating it renders room 1.
1 mark for explaining the component ignores the route's `:roomNumber` parameter.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 用户刷新 `/travel/42/room/3`。组件渲染的是哪个房间？当前的路由设置缺少了什么信息？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 它渲染的是 room 1，因为组件总是把 `roomNumber` 初始化为 1。路由里虽然声明了 `:roomNumber` 参数，但组件并没有去读取这个参数、也没有把它作为初始或受控的房间号。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：答出渲染的是 room 1。
1 分：解释组件忽略了路由里的 `:roomNumber` 参数。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: The user clicks "Next" on room 3. Why is changing only React state not enough for the desired behaviour of the app?
subQuestions.answerMdx: The visible room may change, but the URL still says room 3. A refresh or a copied link will therefore lose the user's position, because the route is the source of the room number for a directly addressable page.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for noting the URL still shows room 3.
1 mark for explaining a refresh / copied link loses the position because the route is the source of truth.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 用户在 room 3 上点了 "Next"。为什么只修改 React state 不足以实现这个应用想要的行为？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 可见的房间也许变了，但 URL 里仍然写着 room 3。因此刷新页面或把一个复制出去的链接发给别人，都会丢失用户当前的位置，因为对于一个可直接寻址的页面来说，路由才是房间号的来源。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：指出 URL 仍然显示 room 3。
1 分：解释刷新 / 复制链接会丢失位置，因为路由才是真值来源。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Describe how the component should use the route when it loads and when "Next" is clicked. Do not write code.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Read both `hotelId` and `roomNumber` from the matched route and render the room identified by those values. On a button click, navigate to the same hotel with the next room number in the URL; the route change then causes the displayed room to update.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for reading `hotelId` and `roomNumber` from the route to render the room.
1 mark for navigating to a new URL (the next room) on click rather than only setting state.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请描述：组件在加载时以及点击 "Next" 时，应如何使用路由？不要写代码。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 从匹配到的路由里同时读取 `hotelId` 和 `roomNumber`，并渲染由这两个值确定的房间。点击按钮时，导航到同一家酒店、但房间号加一的 URL；随后路由的变化会带动所显示房间的更新。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：从路由读取 `hotelId` 和 `roomNumber` 来渲染房间。
1 分：点击时导航到一个新 URL（下一个房间），而不是只修改 state。

questions.title: Navbar links
questions.contentMdx: A Qanda-style app keeps the logged-in user's token in React state. The login page calls `setToken` after a successful login and navigates to `/dashboard`. `qanda-pages.svg` shows the dashboard and profile pages with the navbar. `App.jsx` contains the code.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Mei logs in and lands on `/dashboard`. She clicks "Profile" in the navbar and is sent to `/login` instead of her profile. Explain what the browser does when she clicks the link, and why that logs her out.
subQuestions.answerMdx: An `<a href>` makes the browser do a full page load: it requests `/profile` from the server and starts the whole app again from scratch. All React state is thrown away, so `token` is back to `null`, and the `/profile` route sends her to `/login`.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining `<a href>` triggers a full page load / app restart.
1 mark for linking that to the loss of `token` state and the redirect to `/login`.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: Mei 登录后落在 `/dashboard`。她点击导航栏里的 "Profile"，却被送到了 `/login`，而不是她的个人主页。请解释她点击这个链接时浏览器做了什么，以及为什么这会把她登出。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: `<a href>` 会让浏览器做一次整页加载：它向服务器请求 `/profile`，并从头把整个应用重新启动一遍。所有 React state 都被丢弃，于是 `token` 又变回 `null`，`/profile` 路由便把她送去了 `/login`。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：解释 `<a href>` 会触发整页加载 / 应用重启。
1 分：把这一点与 `token` state 丢失、并被重定向到 `/login` 联系起来。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Describe a change to the navbar that keeps Mei logged in when she clicks between pages, and explain what is different about how it navigates.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Use React Router's `<Link to="/profile">` (and `<Link to="/dashboard">`) instead of `<a href>`. `Link` stops the browser's normal page load, updates the URL, and lets the router render the matching route inside the same running app. `App` is never restarted, so `token` survives.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for replacing `<a href>` with React Router's `<Link to>`.
1 mark for explaining `Link` prevents the full page load so the app (and `token`) keeps running.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 请描述一种对导航栏的改法，让 Mei 在页面之间点击时保持登录状态，并说明它的导航方式有什么不同。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 把 `<a href>` 换成 React Router 的 `<Link to="/profile">`（以及 `<Link to="/dashboard">`）。`Link` 会阻止浏览器进行常规的整页加载，只更新 URL，并让路由在同一个仍在运行的应用内渲染匹配的路由。`App` 永远不会被重启，所以 `token` 得以保留。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：把 `<a href>` 换成 React Router 的 `<Link to>`。
1 分：解释 `Link` 阻止了整页加载，因此应用（及 `token`）持续运行。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: Even with that fix, Mei is still sent to `/login` whenever she presses the browser's refresh button. Why is a refresh different from clicking a `Link`, and what else needs to change?
subQuestions.answerMdx: Refreshing always does a full page load, which `Link` avoids, so the React state, including `token`, is lost again no matter how she navigated. The token has to be stored somewhere that survives a reload, such as `localStorage`, and read back when the app starts (for example as the initial value of the state).
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for explaining a refresh is always a full page load, so state is lost.
1 mark for persisting the token (e.g. `localStorage`) and restoring it on start.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 即使做了这个修改，只要 Mei 按下浏览器的刷新按钮，她还是会被送到 `/login`。为什么刷新与点击 `Link` 不同？还应该改什么？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 因为刷新总会做一次整页加载，而这正是 `Link` 所避免的，所以无论她是怎么导航过来的，包括 `token` 在内的 React state 都会再次丢失。必须把 token 存到能在刷新后存活的地方，例如 `localStorage`，并在应用启动时读回来（比如作为 state 的初始值）。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：解释刷新总是一次整页加载，所以 state 会丢失。
1 分：把 token 持久化（如 `localStorage`）并在启动时恢复。

questions.title: Profile pages
questions.contentMdx: The Qanda app has profile pages. `/profile/:name` shows that user's profile, and the "My profile" link in the navbar goes to `/profile`. `profile-pages.svg` shows the dashboard navbar and the profile page layout. `Profile.jsx` contains the code.

subQuestions.label: (a)
subQuestions.questionMdx: The user opens `/profile/emily`. What does the page show, and how does `Profile` know which name to show?
subQuestions.answerMdx: "EMILY's profile". `/profile/:name` matches it: the `:name` part is a wildcard that matches any value in that position. `useParams` returns an object of the wildcard values from the URL, here `{ name: 'emily' }`, so `name` is "emily".
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for stating it shows "EMILY's profile".
1 mark for explaining `:name` is a wildcard and `useParams` supplies it.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 用户打开 `/profile/emily`。页面显示什么？`Profile` 又是怎么知道该显示哪个名字的？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 显示 "EMILY's profile"。`/profile/:name` 会匹配它：其中 `:name` 段是一个通配符，能匹配该位置上的任意值。`useParams` 会返回一个由 URL 中通配符值组成的对象，这里是 `{ name: 'emily' }`，所以 `name` 就是 "emily"。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：答出显示 "EMILY's profile"。
1 分：解释 `:name` 是通配符，并由 `useParams` 提供。

subQuestions.label: (b)
subQuestions.questionMdx: The user clicks "My profile", which goes to `/profile`. What happens, and why?
subQuestions.answerMdx: The page goes blank and the console shows an error like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')". `/profile` matches the route that renders the same `Profile` component, but that route has no `:name` wildcard, so `useParams()` returns an empty object and `name` is `undefined`. Calling `toUpperCase` on `undefined` throws while rendering, and React removes the page.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for stating the page goes blank / an error is thrown.
1 mark for explaining `name` is `undefined` because the `/profile` route has no `:name`, so `toUpperCase` throws.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 用户点击 "My profile"，它指向 `/profile`。会发生什么？为什么？
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 页面会变成空白，控制台会出现类似 "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toUpperCase')" 的报错。`/profile` 匹配到的路由会渲染同一个 `Profile` 组件，但那条路由没有 `:name` 通配符，所以 `useParams()` 返回一个空对象，`name` 为 `undefined`。在 `undefined` 上调用 `toUpperCase` 会在渲染过程中抛错，React 随即把这个页面移除。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：答出页面变空白 / 抛出了错误。
1 分：解释因为 `/profile` 路由没有 `:name`，所以 `name` 是 `undefined`，于是 `toUpperCase` 抛错。

subQuestions.label: (c)
subQuestions.questionMdx: A teammate's fix is to delete the `/profile` route. What does `/profile` show now, and why? Then describe a better fix.
subQuestions.answerMdx: Nothing from the routes (only the navbar is displayed). React Router matches a route's whole path, and `/profile` does not match `/profile/:name`, which needs a value after `/profile/`. No route matches, so nothing is rendered for the page. A better fix is to keep both routes and have `Profile` check whether `name` exists: if it does not, render something else, such as "Please enter a name" with a search box, or the logged-in user's own profile.
subQuestions.markingMdx:
1 mark for stating nothing is rendered because no route matches `/profile`.
1 mark for a better fix that keeps both routes and has `Profile` handle a missing `name`.
subQuestions.questionMdxZh: 队友的修法是删掉 `/profile` 这条路由。现在访问 `/profile` 会显示什么？为什么？然后请描述一个更好的修法。
subQuestions.answerMdxZh: 不会有任何来自路由的内容（只显示导航栏）。React Router 会匹配路由的完整路径，而 `/profile` 并不匹配 `/profile/:name`，后者要求在 `/profile/` 之后必须有一个值。既然没有路由匹配，页面就什么都不渲染。更好的修法是保留两条路由，并让 `Profile` 检查 `name` 是否存在：如果不存在，就渲染别的内容，例如带搜索框的 "Please enter a name"，或当前登录用户自己的主页。
subQuestions.markingMdxZh:
1 分：答出因为没有任何路由匹配 `/profile`，所以什么都不渲染。
1 分：给出更好的修法——保留两条路由，并让 `Profile` 处理 `name` 缺失的情况。
